reply: No, nothing on Ethos is monthly. Templates, "Make it special" and game packs are one-time payments that stay on your account for good, for example one template is €9.99, paid once. Ethos for Two is €29.99 for a year, paid once for both of you, and it doesn't renew by itself: we email you two weeks before it ends.

One template is $11.99, paid once, and it's yours for good. That includes making it as often as you like, your voice or video, up to 20 photos with no footer, opening at midnight on their day, and a password so only they can open it. You can try any template's live demo for free first at tryethos.io/templates.

Make it special is £6.49, paid once, for a free template (The Letter or Constellations). It adds that template's paid extras for good: a video, a voice message, up to 20 photos, no footer, scheduling and a password.

Ethos doesn't have discount codes: the price shown is the same for everyone. What is free: The Letter and Constellations templates, every template's live demo, the editor with its live preview, and sending a gift back once in the same template when you receive a paid one.

Yes. Every template has a full live demo you can play for free from its page on tryethos.io/templates, and the editor is free to use with a live preview. You only pay when you publish something that needs a premium feature. The Letter and Constellations are free to use in full.

For gifts, two templates are fully free, The Letter and Constellations, with unlimited gifts, up to 10 photos each, our music library, a 30-second preview of a real song, a countdown and a hidden final surprise, plus a small "Made with Ethos" footer. Every template has a free live demo, and the editor with its live preview is free too. You can also find and plan dates with the forecast and sunset, use the long-distance tools and play the games, and a free account keeps up to three saved dates or trips. If someone sends you a paid gift, you can send one back in the same template for free, once.

No, gift links don't expire: they're meant to be permanent. If that ever had to change, you'd get at least 90 days' notice. You can also edit a gift after it's live, and the changes show at the same link.

Yes, you can fix it. Sign in and open My gifts (tryethos.io/dashboard), then tap "Edit" on the gift. Correct the typo and publish: the change goes live at the same link straight away, so there's no need to send a new one.
Yes. Checkout runs on Stripe's page, which takes card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and other methods, and it shows the final amount in your currency before you pay.

Ethos for Two is a year of everything for the two of you, for $34.99 paid once: unlimited saved dates and trips planned together on both your phones, a reminder the day before each date, a whole date opened in Apple or Google Maps, and every gift template and game pack. One of you pays, and your partner joins with the invite link you send them. It lasts 365 days and doesn't renew by itself; we email you two weeks before it ends.

Yes. If you send a gift made with a premium template that you paid for, they can send you one back in the same template for free, once, with the small "Made with Ethos" footer. If they want extras like video, voice or no footer on their reply, they pay that template's normal price, €9.99.

Yes, a gift can be scheduled to unlock at a set time, so it opens at midnight on her birthday. Scheduling comes with any paid template (One template is €9.99, paid once), with Ethos for Two, or with "Make it special" (€7.49, paid once) on the free templates The Letter or Constellations. You can try any template's live demo and the editor for free first at tryethos.io/templates.

Yes. The Letter is free, and adding a voice message comes with "Make it special" (€7.49, paid once), which also gives that template a video, up to 20 photos, no footer, scheduling and a password, forever. A voice message is also included if you unlock a premium plan, such as One template (€9.99) or Everything (€24.99), or with Ethos for Two. You can try it all in the editor for free and only pay when you publish.
No, there's no app to install. The gift opens in any phone or computer browser from the link or QR code, and he doesn't need an account either.
Yes. The site and every gift are available in both English and Spanish, so you can make your gift in Spanish.

Yes, you can. Because you've already bought one template, you pay Everything's price (£21.99) minus the £8.99 you paid, so £13.00, and never less than £4.99. Everything gives you all templates, now and future, and as many gifts as you like, forever.

On a free gift (The Letter or Constellations) you can add up to 10 photos. With any template unlock, Ethos for Two, or "Make it special" on a free template (€7.49, paid once), you can add up to 20 photos per gift.

Game packs are extra decks for the games, with more questions and bolder dares, while the games themselves stay free. Each pack is €2.99, paid once and yours for good. Every pack is also included with Ethos for Two while it runs.

Lots of them! For a birthday, the free option is Constellations, and premium ones include Balloons, Pop-up Card, Birthday Cinema, Party Animals, Sketchbook, Digicam, Scrapbook, Bouquet, Kawaii, Arcade, Midnight Countdown, Front Page, Scratch Card and Pack Your Bags. It depends on what you bought. Templates, "Make it special" and game packs unlock straight away at checkout, so there's no change-of-mind refund, but if a gift won't open or play properly on their phone or computer and we can't fix it, tell us within 30 days of buying and you get your money back. Ethos for Two can be withdrawn within 14 days of buying, refunded minus the days already used, and gift cards are refunded in full within 14 days if the code hasn't been redeemed. The page tryethos.io/legal/withdraw, linked at the foot of every page, explains how to ask.

Here's how to get to it: a gift stays saved on the phone or computer it was made on until it's published.
1. On that same phone or computer, sign in with the email you paid with.
2. Open My gifts (tryethos.io/dashboard).
3. At the top it says "Your (template) gift is paid for": tap "Finish and send it".
4. On a different phone the draft isn't there, so make the gift again in the same template; it's already unlocked on your account, with nothing more to pay.

Each sign-in link works once, for an hour, and a newer email replaces any earlier one. Here's how to get in:
1. Go back to the sign-in page and type your email to get a new link and a 6-digit code.
2. Open the newest email and tap its link, or type the 6-digit code from it.
3. If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, check your spam and promotions folders, then ask for a new one.
Use the same email you paid with, so your purchases show on your account.

Sorry about that. Here's what to try:
1. Wait a few minutes, then check your spam and promotions folders.
2. If it's not there, ask for a new link on the sign-in page.
3. Use the link or the 6-digit code from your newest email, since each new one replaces the last, and each link works once, for an hour.
Make sure you sign in with the same email you paid with, so your purchases show up on your account.

Si pagaste como invitado, el regalo se guarda en el teléfono u ordenador donde lo creaste hasta que se publica. Para encontrarlo:
1. Inicia sesión con el mismo correo con el que pagaste, en ese mismo teléfono u ordenador.
2. Abre Mis regalos (tryethos.io/dashboard).
3. Arriba verás "Tu regalo (plantilla) está pagado": toca "Terminar y enviarlo".
Si estás en otro teléfono, el borrador no estará ahí: vuelve a crear el regalo con la misma plantilla, que ya está desbloqueada en tu cuenta, así que no tendrás que pagar nada más.
